# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a single-page browser-native turn-based creature battle. The player starts from a menu, enters a story screen, then fights three rival encounters with four command buttons. HP bars, a bond/finisher meter, enemy timed counterattacks, result screens, continue/rematch, particles, canvas animation, and catalog-backed audio are the core runtime surfaces.

## Protected mechanics
- Start route -> story -> combat -> result -> next/rematch flow.
- Four commands: light attack, stronger attack, cheer/charge, and finisher gated by full bond meter.
- HP damage, enemy AI counterattacks on a timer, win/loss by HP reaching zero, three rival chapters, and restart/new-run semantics.
- Mobile tap/click buttons, canvas ambience, HUD bars, feedback text, and audio unlock on user gesture.

## Transformable surfaces
Title, world terms, focal creature identity, rival names, HUD vocabulary, menu/story/result copy, palette roles, canvas background motifs, procedural creature styling, route props, feedback labels, and catalog-backed audio/font choices are presentation-facing and safe to transform.

## Target remix
`ChromaBud Quest League` reframes the existing battle loop as a Pokemon-inspired coming-of-age creature-collector route. The player is a rookie scout bonding with Lumicub, completing Atlas stamps against rival scouts, collecting elemental entries, and charging Evo Spark through touch-friendly command menus.
